description: This file defines the SystemCheckController class within the OrangeHRM installer upgrader module. It extends an abstract controller class and overrides the preRender method to set up a Vue component for the system check screen, as well as update application state.

classes.name: SystemCheckController
classes.description: Controller for system check step during installation upgrade, setting up Vue component and application state

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the system check Vue component and updates the current screen state before rendering
